environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/fetch-metadata-restricted.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for the connect(2) syscall on AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket families where the destination falls within RFC 1918 ranges or link-local (169.254.0.0/16). Additionally, the pod runs with a Cilium L4 network policy that applies an egress deny rule for CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80, and a separate CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy denies egress to 10.0.0.0/8 on all ports for pods labeled app=fetch-metadata. The seccomp profile also blocks raw_socket creation (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on socket() with SOCK_RAW type).

config.note: seccomp BPF filtering operates at syscall argument level; Cilium policy enforces at network layer independently
